shared_elements: schematic central figure or face-like form
justification: The main correspondence is that both use a schematic, geometric vocabulary with a prominent circular element incorporated into a central figure or face-like form, accompanied by simple linear marks. The biggest difference is that A shows a flat pictographic figure with concentric target-like body, limb-like extensions, a separate dot, and a lower linear band, while B shows an upright anthropomorphic carved form dominated by facial features and stacked body/head zones.
